steps.content: Letting out a final shriek, the monster vanishes along with all traces of Mania. The alley, though still cold and dim without sunlight, has regained peace. Only the faint, ghostly scent of datura flowers still lingers in the air around you.
The shackles pulse wildly in your palm. A strong premonition tells you that the Sinner before you deserves every bit of the Outland Affairs Bureau's high-risk rating.
You step back instinctively to keep a safe distance, only to realize she's still holding your wrist. Sensing your retreat, her fingers tighten gently around yours.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: What, are you afraid of me? Did they badmouth me while I was away? Primrose and her friends wouldn't do that. It was Juan, wasn't it?

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: And here I thought you were a brave one, venturing alone into such a desolate place. Lucky for you, I happened to have stumbled upon a lost little lamb.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Don't I deserve at least a merci?

She tilts her head, lips drawing closer to your ear. Her warm breath, tinged with a faint hint of tobacco, brushes against the nape of your neck, sending a shiver down your spine. She notices, of course, but maintains her composure, awaiting your response.
She's not the only one here who can feign calmness after a monster encounter...

Ahem... How strange. I'm not quite sure how I ended up here. Just now, a dark shape appeared out of nowhere, and the next thing I knew, I could barely breathe. Thank you for your help... I should head back now.
You put on a meek, confused look and try to pull your hand free, but she isn't about to let you go that easily.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Is that all? Surely you can do better than that, my friend.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: You see, in my line of work, nothing comes for free.

With her tone honeyed yet firm, she steps forward, guiding you back until your shoulders meet the wall. With deliberate calm, she takes your hand, her fingers lacing through yours, fingertip tracing soft, slow circles that leave a tingling warmth on your palm.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Now, as a token of your gratitude, humor me: What was that red glow in your palm?

So much for hiding the shackles. I'm the MBCC's Chief from DisCity. Surrender now! Part of you has always wanted to pull off a dramatic line like that for once, but with so many mysteries unsolved, it's no time for heroics just yet.

options: Play dumb and change the subject

steps.content: What red glow? What do you mean? All I remember is something scary trying to attack me... It was all a blur after that.
I think I heard that shadowy figure say something. Something about... Vautour Bleu's lie?

You emphasize those last words, widening your eyes in feigned innocence. Looking into her blue eyes, you'd expect some astuteness from a shrewd merchant, but instead, you see only a placid yet penetrating gaze.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: No way. An attack, here in Désir? That would be quite concerning. We certainly wouldn't want to frighten the townsfolk away, would we? Looks like I've got some tidying up to do, to make sure any threat to Désir is... erased.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Now, just to be absolutely clear... You're certain you were attacked by some shadowy figure?

Her deliberate slow tone says it all. She's playing the same game as you are, keeping her cards close while threatening discreetly. It's clear she's dodging the mention of her "lie" and the presence of the Corruptor.
You both keep your friendly, knowing smiles in silence. Any passerby would think you're just having an amiable talk.
As her fingertips brush against your wrist, you feel your pulse quicken. You can control your tone and even expression, but your body betrays you.
Must we stand this close? Frankly, I'd be quite defenseless if you decided to take advantage of the situation, Miss Vautour Bleu.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Oh? How did you know my name? I don't recall introducing myself.
Didn't you just mention that I'm your new neighbor?
I've only just arrived in Désir and haven't had the chance to get to know you. I'd hate to end up being one of those shadowy figures we were just talking about.

Broaching this subject is a gamble. No one in town knows you're here, alone in this alley. If Vautour Bleu wanted to, she could just say you'd successfully snuck into DisCity—just like she did with Sheila.
But you're betting she has reasons to keep her hands clean, just like she's reluctant to acknowledge the monster's existence. You suspect she has her own secrets.

Her gaze sharpens, as if she's seen through your ploy. In the dim alley, two sets of breath and body heat intertwine with mutual hostility. In the looming silence, you're acutely aware of her skin against your wrist, the touch growing hotter with each passing second.
Your gamble pays off. She releases your hand.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Hmm, what an unexpected way to meet my new neighbor. Thank goodness it was all just a misunderstanding.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I'm glad you're alright. You can relax now. In Désir, we don't ask where people come from—everyone's bound for the same destination. When you're ready to make that trip to DisCity, come see me. Bring your bargaining chips... and your sincerity, of course.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Until then, make the most of your time here in Désir.
She brushes past you out of the dark alley, seamlessly blending into the bustling town center as if nothing happened. Only the lingering scent and warmth in her wake remind you of the silent tension.
Just as you breathe a discreet sigh of relief while watching her walking away, she suddenly pauses, casting a quick glance over her shoulder.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: Ah, although you seem to know me already, it wouldn't be proper to not introduce myself as a gracious host.

steps.speaker: Vautour Bleu
steps.content: I am Vautour Bleu, the owner of Désir. May you have pleasant dreams tonight.
